# Hit Your Mark Travel — https://www.hymtravel.com
# Posture: allow search and retrieval for AI answers, opt out of model training.
# Content Signals state usage preferences; vendor-specific Disallow directives
# reinforce the training restriction where providers document separate bots.
# For mixed-purpose bots, the signal alone may not prevent training.
# Existing conventional search and user-directed retrieval remain accessible.

# ── Search engines ──
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

# ── AI answer engines: search and user-directed retrieval ──
# Distinct from training crawlers. These support AI answer citations.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Meta-ExternalAgent
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: Amazonbot
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

# ── Training crawlers / training-use tokens: block model training ──
# GPTBot and ClaudeBot are training crawlers. Their providers use Disallow
# to recognize training opt-outs; OAI-SearchBot and Claude-SearchBot stay open.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

# Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are usage-control tokens, not
# independent crawlers. Disallow protects the defined training uses without
# blocking Googlebot/Applebot search. Google-Extended also controls grounding
# in some Gemini products; this is an intentional training-first tradeoff.
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

# ── Harvest-only crawlers: no citation surface, no upside ──
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Diffbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: cohere-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: cohere-training-data-crawler
Disallow: /

User-agent: Timpibot
Disallow: /

User-agent: omgili
Disallow: /

User-agent: omgilibot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Webzio-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: ImagesiftBot
Disallow: /

# ── SEO crawlers: allowed but throttled ──
User-agent: AhrefsBot
Crawl-delay: 10
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: SemrushBot
Crawl-delay: 10
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

User-agent: dotbot
Crawl-delay: 10
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

# ── Everything else ──
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
